description: Manage evidence collection tasks (editor+): create one against a tracking record, update its fields, or mark it completed with notes. Pick with method.

assigned_user_id.description: Assignee user UUID — obtain from scf_list_members Used by: create, update.

completion_notes.description: Notes recorded on completion Used by: update, complete.

description.description: What has to be collected and how Used by: create, update.

due_date.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD Used by: create, update.

evidence_tracking_id.description: Evidence tracking record UUID (the id field from scf_list_evidence, not the E-xxx catalog id) Used by: create.

method.description:
create: Create a manual evidence collection task against a tracking record (write — editor role). Due date and evidence_tracking_id are required; status defaults to not_started, priority to medium.
update: Update an evidence collection task (write — editor role). Only passed fields change: due date, status, type, priority, title, description, notes, assignee, owning team.
complete: Mark an evidence collection task completed (write — editor role). Sets status to completed and stamps the completion date; optional completion notes are stored with it.

owning_team_id.description: Team that owns the task — obtain from scf_list_teams Used by: create, update.

priority.description: Priority (default medium) [create] | Priority [update] Used by: create, update.

status.description: Initial status (default not_started) [create] | Status [update] Used by: create, update.

task_id.description: Evidence task UUID — obtain from scf_list_evidence_tasks Used by: update, complete.

task_type.description: Task type (default collection) [create] | Task type [update] Used by: create, update.

title.description: Task title Used by: create, update.

name: scf_evidence_task_write
